arrays.counts: Muon counts per shower in 30 one-meter radial bins. Bin j, starting at zero, spans [30+j, 31+j) m.
arrays.totals: Total muon count per shower over all radii, with the same energy cut.

row_order: Ascending CORSIKA run number, from 300001 to 308192.
fit: The fit uses the summed counts in the 30–60 m bins and the count outside that interval as one additional bin. The radial scale is fixed at 320 m.
